title: Laminar flow in the needle
caption: Laminar flow in a tube has a parabolic velocity profile, fastest on the axis (v_max = Δp R²/4ηL = 16.7 m s⁻¹) and zero at the wall. The mean speed is half of that, 8.3 m s⁻¹, and the flow through the area πR² is Q = 1.05 × 10⁻⁶ m³ s⁻¹ = 1 mL s⁻¹.
alt: Graph of fluid speed against radius in the needle: a parabola from 16.7 metres per second on the axis down to zero at the wall at 0.2 millimetres.
description: The horizontal axis is distance from the axis in mm, from 0 to the wall at R = 0.2 mm; the vertical axis is speed v(r).
v(r) = v_max(1 − r²/R²) with v_max = Δp R²/4ηL = 16.7 m s⁻¹.
Adding up v × 2πr dr over the cross-section gives Q = πR⁴Δp/8ηL = 1.05 × 10⁻⁶ m³ s⁻¹, equal to the mean speed 8.3 m s⁻¹ times πR².

checks.name: no slip: v = 0 at the wall
∫ v 2πr dr = 1.05 × 10⁻⁶ m³/s, the Poiseuille flow rate
